name: Institution profiles and identifiers
acceptance: Two scoped profiles cannot read/change each other

name: Validated case intake
implementation_target: Unique durable case reference, session, evidence, reload/restart

name: Versioned policy registry
acceptance: Old case pinned; draft revision never executes

name: Explainable route selection
implementation_target: Two source-linked conditional routes; X=360 review
acceptance: NBA and no-NBA branches differ, boundary review

name: Server-guarded transitions
acceptance: Illegal skip and arbitrary stage denied

name: Signed scrutiny and re-scrutiny
implementation_target: Immutable checklist and D1/D2 correction guard
acceptance: D1/D2 allowed; C3 denied, history retained

name: Conditional EVC tasks
implementation_target: Eligible task, one active task, report evidence
acceptance: Only eligible qualifying route gets one EVC

name: Human-only authority decision
acceptance: Admin decision denied; demo authority event approved

name: Linked undertakings and obligations
implementation_target: Condition generates exactly one sourced obligation

name: Private document version and validity
implementation_target: Real file bytes, versions, review, renewal history
acceptance: Submitted never auto-verified; old version retained

name: Timers reminders escalation
acceptance: Duplicate retry once; stale timer suppressed

name: Role dashboards/pendency
implementation_target: Scoped, committed counts and current ages
acceptance: Count matches committed records and scope

name: Audit logs and reports
implementation_target: Atomic events with actor/source; safe exports
acceptance: One committed event; deny has audit; no fake hash

name: Security/RBAC/operations
implementation_target: Fail-closed auth, scoped files, safe secrets/ops
